cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 professional wrappers are generic; A3 peas and A5 solo late dinner make the gracious cost visible.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 no food causes A3 minimising breakfast reassurance; B4 delayed pizza causes A5 public waiting and solo meal.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices A sacrifice and B4 offers actual replacement food, making the developing inconvenience relational rather than arbitrary.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 helpful pizza into an extended conspicuous hosting period.

specificity.evidence: A1 extra brother and B2 A unfed establish the sacrifice.
